title: Bus Route Overcrowding Analysis from Ticketing Data
description: Uses boarding records to find which routes and time bands exceed seat capacity, and quantifies how much extra service would be needed to bring them under a target load.

title: Fuel Price Pass-Through Analysis
description: Estimates how quickly and fully changes in crude oil prices reach pump prices using lagged regression, and tests whether prices rise faster than they fall.

title: School Dropout Funnel Analysis by Region
description: Tracks cohorts of students from enrolment to completion across regions, locates where in the school system the largest losses occur and charts the gaps between regions.

title: Retail Basket Co-Purchase Network Explorer
description: Builds a network of products that are bought together, detects communities of related items and lets a merchandiser explore which groups should sit on the same shelf.

title: Simpson's Paradox Teaching Dashboard
description: Demonstrates how an overall trend can reverse inside every subgroup using real tables, letting learners toggle groupings to see the reversal appear and disappear.

title: Survey Weighting and Margin of Error Calculator
description: Applies post-stratification weights to a skewed survey sample and reports how weighting changes estimates and their margins of error, with the method explained step by step.

title: Public Library Usage Trends Dashboard
description: Summarises borrowing, visits and programme attendance across branches and years, highlighting seasonal patterns and branches whose use is declining.

title: Bike Lane Safety Analysis from Crash Records
description: Combines crash records with infrastructure data to compare injury rates on streets with and without protected lanes, adjusting for traffic volume before drawing any conclusion.

title: Wage Gap Decomposition Study
description: Splits an observed pay difference between groups into the part explained by job, experience and education and the unexplained remainder, and discusses what the method can and cannot show.

title: Water Quality Compliance Tracker
description: Compares periodic water sample results with legal limits, flags exceedances by location and parameter, and charts how long each site has been compliant.

title: Sleep and Study Habit Survey Analysis
description: Analyses a class survey on sleep and study time with correlation, grouped comparisons and clear charts, and practises stating limitations honestly.

title: Electricity Bill Anomaly Finder for Households
description: Flags months when a household bill deviates from its own seasonal pattern and suggests probable reasons from weather and appliance changes recorded by the user.

title: Housing Rent Gradient Around Transit Stations
description: Measures how rents change with distance to rail stations using hedonic regression and spatial controls, and maps where the premium is largest.

title: Exam Question Difficulty and Discrimination Analysis
description: Computes item difficulty and discrimination indices from exam results and flags questions that are too easy, too hard or that top students answer worse than weaker ones.

title: Bootstrap Confidence Interval Explorer
description: Lets users resample a small dataset to see how the sampling distribution of a statistic emerges, and compares bootstrap intervals with textbook formulas.

title: Mobile Plan Cost Optimiser from Usage History
description: Recommends the cheapest mobile plan for a user's own call, data and message history by costing every plan against past months, including overage charges.

title: Event Attendance Forecasting for Campus Fests
description: Predicts attendance for campus events from past editions, weekday, weather and promotion channels, and reports forecast error separately for large and small events.

title: Agricultural Commodity Price Seasonality Study
description: Decomposes market price series for crops into trend, seasonal and irregular parts and identifies the months when farmers historically received the best and worst prices.

title: Open Government Contract Spending Explorer
description: Cleans public procurement records, groups spending by supplier and category and highlights concentration, such as a few suppliers receiving most of a department's budget.

title: Weather Station Data Quality Checker
description: Screens weather station records for impossible values, stuck sensors and gaps, and produces a quality report with the share of readings usable for analysis.

title: Customer Complaint Resolution Time Analysis
description: Analyses time to resolve complaints by category and team, identifies slow stages in the process and tests whether a new triage rule changed resolution times.

title: Digital Payment Adoption Study Across Districts
description: Maps the spread of digital payment usage across districts over several years and relates it to infrastructure and literacy indicators, with attention to correlation limits.

title: Lifetime Fitness Activity Trend Analyser
description: Analyses exported step and workout logs to show weekly trends, longest streaks and the days of the week a person is most and least active.

title: Language Learning Progress Analytics
description: Analyses a learner's review history from a flashcard app to estimate retention curves, spot the cards that keep failing and recommend when to review them.

title: Counterfactual Sales Impact of a Store Redesign
description: Estimates what sales would have been without a store layout change by constructing a synthetic control from similar stores, and reports uncertainty honestly.

title: Metro Ridership Recovery Tracker
description: Compares ridership after a disruption with a pre-disruption baseline by station and weekday, showing how quickly each part of the network recovered.
